beta.banner_text: Commerce Module Beta Version — for preview and feedback only.
beta.modal_intro: This is a beta mock of the Commerce feature of the Middle East project.
beta.modal_description: It is provided to show what has been built so far, how store management, products, cart, and sales flows are intended to work, and where the platform is heading.
beta.modal_warning: This version is not designed for real business operations, live selling, or production use.
beta.modal_goal_title: The goal of this beta is to:
beta.goal_1: Let you explore the current commerce experience
beta.goal_3: Identify what works and what doesn’t
beta.goal_4: Collect your feedback to improve and expand the system
beta.modal_footer: Many features are intentionally limited, simulated, or incomplete. Your feedback at this stage directly influences how the platform will be developed next.

home.title: Welcome to Middle East Commerce
home.subtitle: Discover products, explore stores, or start your own commerce journey.

browse.title: 🛍 Browse & Shop
browse.p1: This is the main browsing page where you can discover and buy items from any category across the platform.
browse.p2: Explore products from different stores, compare options, and find what fits your needs—all in one place.

language.title: 🌍 Language & Country-Based View
language.p1: Use the language and country selector to view products that are available in the selected country.
language.p2: This helps ensure you see:Relevant products, local availability, and country-specific listings.
language.p3: Your browsing experience adapts based on your selection.

seller.title: 🏬 Become a Seller
seller.p1: Middle East is not just for buying.
seller.p2: Any user can create their own store, list products, and start their individual commerce journey.
seller.p3: Whether you are an individual seller or a business, the platform is designed to help you reach customers and generate income.

recommendations.title: 🤖 Smart Recommendations (Coming Soon)
recommendations.p1: A smart recommendation system will be added in a future phase.
recommendations.p2: It will help personalize your shopping experience by suggesting relevant products, related items, and stores based on your interests and activity.
recommendations.p3: This feature is part of the upcoming platform expansion.

sidebar.title: ☰ Access Your Profile & Tools
sidebar.p1: You can access your profile and all available beta tools from the sidebar menu.
sidebar.p2: From there, you can manage: Your account and security, stores and products, orders and wishlist, support and feedback tools.
sidebar.p3: Some tools may be limited or in preview mode during the beta.

closing.title: Before You Continue
closing.p1: This home page brings buyers and sellers together in one evolving commerce environment.
closing.p2: Explore freely, try features during the beta, and share your feedback to help shape the platform.

profile.title: How to Navigate Your Account
profile.subtitle: A quick overview of the sections available in your account during the beta phase.

overview.title: Overview
overview.p1: This menu gives you access to all main areas of your account on the Middle East Commerce platform.
overview.p2: Some sections are fully available, while others are in preview or limited mode during beta.

personal_info.title: Personal Information
personal_info.desc: Manage your company profile, contact details, and basic business information. This defines how your account and store appear on the platform.

devices.title: Devices Management
devices.desc: View and manage the devices currently linked to your account. This helps test security and session management.

wishlist.title: Wishlist
wishlist.desc: Save products you’re interested in and revisit them later.

orders.title: Orders
orders.desc: View and track orders created within the beta environment. Orders here are for testing purposes only.

addresses.title: Addresses
addresses.desc: Manage your saved billing and shipping addresses for future checkout flows.

security.title: Security
security.desc: Update your password and review basic account security settings.

store.title: Store Management
store.desc: Access tools related to store setup, products, and commerce configuration.

trash.title: Trashed Items
trash.desc: Review items that were removed but not permanently deleted during testing.

compare.title: Compare Products
compare.desc: Compare multiple products side by side to evaluate features and differences.

tickets.title: My Tickets
tickets.desc: Contact support or send feedback directly to the team.

logout.title: Log Out
logout.desc: Safely sign out of your account on the current device.

delete.title: Delete Account
delete.desc: Permanently remove your account and all associated data.

closing.title: Before You Continue
closing.p1: Not all sections are fully active during the beta phase. They are included to show how the full platform will be structured.
closing.p2: Your feedback helps us decide what to improve next.

store.title: Store Management Overview
store.subtitle: Manage your stores, products, and sales settings during the Commerce beta.

overview.title: Overview
overview.p1: This section allows you to manage everything related to your store operations.
overview.p2: You can create and manage multiple stores under the same account.

switching.title: Switching Between Stores
switching.p1: If you manage more than one store, use the store switcher icon to move between stores.
switching.p2: Each store has its own settings, products, orders, and data.
switching.p3: This makes it easy to manage multiple businesses from one account.

store_mgmt.title: Store Management
store_mgmt.desc: Edit your store’s information, branding, location, and public profile.

products.title: Products Management
products.desc: Create, edit, and organize your products, pricing, and availability.

members.title: Store Members
members.desc: Invite and manage team members who have access to this store.

coupons.title: Coupons
coupons.desc: Create and manage discount coupons and promotional offers.

tickets.title: Support Tickets
tickets.desc: View and respond to support requests related to this store.

flash.title: Flash Sales
flash.desc: Configure limited-time offers and flash sales.

orders.title: Orders Management
orders.desc: View and manage orders created within the beta environment.

reviews.title: Reviews
reviews.desc: View and manage customer reviews for your store and products.

settings.title: Settings
settings.desc: Configure store-specific preferences and operational settings.

inventory.title: Inventory Management
inventory.desc: Track and manage product stock and availability.

packages.title: Packages Management
packages.desc: Create and manage bundled products or packages.

closing.title: Before You Continue
closing.p1: This store management area is a beta mock of the commerce system.
closing.p2: It is not intended for live selling or real business operations.
closing.p3: The goal is to explore store workflows and multi-store management.
closing.p4: Your feedback directly influences future commerce features.
